title: Traffic Light Controlled Intersection
summary: Two roads cross. Cars from the four directions cross only when their road has a green light; a turnGreen callback changes the light only when needed; concurrent arrivals must be synchronised.
inputFormat: carCrossesIntersection-style call with car id, direction and the turnGreen and crossCar callbacks; exact argument shapes are not recorded.
outputFormat: No return value; the callbacks are invoked in a valid order.
tieRules: Only one road is green at a time.
edgeRules: The initial green road and direction-to-road mapping are not recorded.
factsPresent: One green road at a time
questions: Which road is green initially, and which road each direction (1 to 4) belongs to?
